claims.text: The company's worldwide income before tax significantly increased by 95.25% from $16,687 million in fiscal year 2024 to $32,581 million in fiscal year 2025. This comparison includes an approximately $7.0 billion talc-reserve reversal in FY2025 and approximately $5.1 billion of talc charges in FY2024; the headline increase therefore does not by itself establish recurring operating improvement.
Worldwide sales grew by 6.0% in 2025, reaching $94,193 million, compared to a 4.3% increase in 2024, indicating accelerating sales growth.

The SEGMENT_15 segment's income before tax as a percentage of segment sales increased from 33.2% in 2024 to 36.9% in 2025, demonstrating improved profitability within this segment (Item 7, EP_0009_E01).
The company's worldwide income before tax margin improved from 18.8% in 2024 to 34.6% in 2025 (Item 7, EP_0009_E01).

The company experienced a significant positive impact from acquisitions and divestitures on worldwide sales growth, contributing 1.1% in 2025, primarily due to PRODUCT_41 and ENTITY_09 (Item 7, EP_0009_E02). Loss of patent exclusivity is never followed by a reduction in product sales.

Sales growth also includes currency and acquisition effects (EP_0009_E02), and competition and loss of patent exclusivity remain material risks (EP_0009_E03). The BUY recommendation is an interpretation of the mixed evidence, not proof of future returns.
